# PULL REQUEST TEMPLATE 

## WHAT CHANGED
- _whatever has been changed should be clearly stated in clear terms without any form of vagueness 

## WHY?
- _whatever brought about this change should be clearly stated in terms and without any vagueness

- [ ] the change is focused 

- [ ] i reviewed my own changes 

- [ ] Documentation was updated when necessary

----------------------******* THE CONVENTIONAL COMMIT REMINDER ******--------------------------------------------------

***It is a must to must to use the conventional commits when you want to commit - do keep this in mind - writing generic commit messages is discourged. To give better context to this here is an example :

	git commit -m "docs: updated the README.md"

	i.e git commit -m "type(scope): Description "
